severityPolicy.note: QAPAQ priority is separate from native Wazuh level; promotion requires validated telemetry and owner-approved thresholds.

detections.name: Phishing con interacción y actividad sospechosa posterior
detections.logic: Correlate a confirmed message/click signal with a risky sign-in or endpoint process/threat for the same identity or device within 60 minutes.

detections.name: Cuenta comprometida y acceso anómalo
detections.logic: Correlate risk/failed-then-success authentication with a new device/network or Cato identity/site anomaly; same identity, bounded window.

detections.name: Malware crítico con actividad de red asociada
detections.logic: Correlate Sophos active high/critical detection/hash/endpoint with Cato threat or allowed outbound destination for same endpoint and time window.

detections.name: Elevación inesperada de privilegios
detections.logic: Alert on privileged role/group assignment; promote to P0 only when actor, target, role and approved change window show no match.
requires: approved change calendar or analyst triage

detections.name: Desactivación de controles de protección
detections.logic: Detect Sophos protection/tamper disablement, Wazuh agent/config drift, or Windows Defender real-time protection disablement; deduplicate by host/control.

detections.name: Password spraying
detections.logic: Threshold failed authentications across distinct identities from one source/network; corroborate with Cato or Entra result and alert on success after spray.

detections.name: Conexión a infraestructura maliciosa
detections.logic: Correlate a Cato threat verdict/destination with Sophos endpoint detection or process/hash on the same host; a block-only event is lower priority.

detections.name: Persistencia sospechosa en endpoints
detections.logic: Detect suspicious Office child process, encoded PowerShell, new scheduled task/service, or protected-path change; corroborate Sophos verdict before escalation.

detections.name: Cambios de reglas de correo o reenvío sospechoso
detections.logic: Alert on forwarding, redirect, delete/hide, transport rules, and mailbox forwarding parameters; review actor, recipient and change context.

detections.name: Descarga o intercambio anómalo de información
detections.logic: Correlate bulk download/export or anonymous share with unusual Cato destination/volume; threshold by user/site baseline and avoid single-event exfil claims.

detections.name: Consentimiento OAuth de riesgo
detections.logic: Detect consent and new application/service-principal credentials; elevate only for sensitive scopes/roles and unapproved actor.
requires: validated operation names and modified properties

detections.name: Cambio de MFA tras inicio de sesión riesgoso
detections.logic: Join security-info registration/deletion with risky or new sign-in for same identity in 60 minutes.

detections.name: Alteración de Conditional Access o federación
detections.logic: Detect domain federation/authentication changes and Conditional Access policy changes; compare with approved change record.

detections.name: Auditoría o controles de buzón deshabilitados
detections.logic: Detect Unified Audit Log ingestion disabled or mailbox audit bypass/disablement.

detections.name: Exportación de eDiscovery o búsqueda sensible
detections.logic: Detect export actions and verify actor, scope, case and authorization; do not classify a search alone as exfiltration.

detections.name: Inicio de sesión de cuenta break-glass
detections.logic: Alert on successful or failed use of an explicitly provisioned emergency account; no account identities are stored in Git.

detections.name: Inicio de sesión de AD seguido de elevación local
detections.logic: Correlate privileged group change or logon type anomaly with host identity and change window.

detections.name: Limpieza del registro de seguridad
detections.logic: Alert on Security log cleared (Windows event 1102) and correlate with privileged logon or control changes.

detections.name: Defensa endpoint manipulada por proceso
detections.logic: Detect known protection-disable command/event and correlate with Sophos tamper state; distinguish approved maintenance.

detections.name: Outlook inicia intérprete o LOLBin
detections.logic: Match Sysmon Event ID 1 parent Outlook to selected high-risk children; analyst triage, not proof of phishing.

detections.name: PowerShell codificado o evasivo
detections.logic: Detect encoded/hidden PowerShell plus suspicious parent or network/process context; do not alert on encoded flag alone.

detections.name: Nueva tarea programada o servicio sospechoso
detections.logic: Detect task/service creation by unusual actor or binary and correlate with signature/hash and Sophos verdict.

detections.name: Cambio de archivo en ruta de persistencia
detections.logic: FIM on explicit autorun/service/config locations; classify by path/hash/owner and correlate Sophos.

detections.name: Ráfaga de intentos SSH
detections.logic: Use native Wazuh Linux authentication rules; raise priority when source maps to Cato/known unusual site and distinct accounts.

detections.name: Uso de sudo y cambios de privilegios Linux
detections.logic: Correlate privilege use with admin inventory, host criticality and change window; report deviations, not every sudo.

detections.name: Remediación Sophos fallida o amenaza persistente
detections.logic: Alert when Sophos threat remains active or core remedy failed; correlate repeated detection/hash and Wazuh agent status.
requires: Sophos SIEM fields for threat/remedy result

detections.name: Amenaza Cato bloqueada con endpoint asociado
detections.logic: Record blocked Cato event as evidence; raise only with endpoint or identity signal, otherwise informational.

detections.name: Subida de datos anómala a destino no habitual
detections.logic: Use provider volume/destination signals and SharePoint export/share events; compare to per-role/site baseline, excluding normal sync by explicit inventory.

detections.name: Creación de enlace anónimo o externo
detections.logic: Alert on anonymous link and correlate object sensitivity/owner/recipient; no assumption that every link is malicious.

detections.name: Agente Wazuh sin heartbeat o con configuración divergente
detections.logic: Detect last-seen breach, missing shared configuration hash, module failures, or Sophos/Wazuh protection mismatch; source silence is degraded, never healthy.
